text:
Night announcement for a peaceful day
Please take a moment

Travelers, your companion animal arrangements need your attention now.

Aurelia Skyways is keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk open for routine checks, handovers, and quick help with pet travel papers. If you are moving with a pet, please stay alert for updates, follow the desk guidance, and keep your paperwork ready. Calm, careful handling matters, and our handlers will continue using humane methods around every animal in our care.

If you are waiting with a pet, please speak up early if anything seems off, from a crate fit to a stress sign or a missing item. Prompt and respectful communication helps us sort problems before they grow. The desk team will answer in plain words and guide you through the next steps without fuss.

This is a good moment to confirm your animal is secure, settled, and easy to identify. A steady hand now can prevent trouble later, and it helps us keep the whole area peaceful for every traveler nearby.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk right away if you need help with your pet journey.
